review reject: The build inserts an int3 directly after the call to LogoutInGameWorldJob::logout (D11). In the original, execution returns from logout and falls through to the epilogue (D12, D13), so the work function returns logout's result as S10 and H12 show. The jne distances change by one (D4/D5, D7/D8) only because of the extra instruction, but the int3 itself is a behavioral difference.
